verification.scope: Actual SPI1 MMIO RDID EID02/22/42, real LX6 store/load of each final physical page (63/127/255), out-of-capacity fault, non-aliasing, unchanged virtual window and reset clearing.

publicConstruction: CLI accepts only 0/2/4/8; WASM returns null for unsupported capacities instead of silently dropping PSRAM. ABI fixture assertions updated; final native ABI/wasm32 build delegated to integration owner.
limitations: Capacity and virtual identity are explicit host scenarios, not measured per-board PSRAM vendor/die identification.
8 MiB backing uses existing MMU page identifiers through the unchanged 4 MiB virtual window; this is not 2T-mode support.
This test does not establish original factory firmware boot or hardware performance.
